name: Macarthurcook
summary: Parent of Tassienet and RuralNet, trading as Local Telecom and Internet Ltd (ASX; formerly MBL Holdings); renamed Macarthurcook Ltd 2003 (ASX code MCK) as a property funds manager; delisted 4 Sep 2009 after AIMS compulsory acquisition.

events.details: Renamed from MBL Holdings Ltd (08 Nov 1996-31 Jan 2000, formerly McDonald Brushware Ltd listed 11 Apr 1991); pivot to telecom operating Tassienet (Sep 1996) and RuralNet brands.
